## feature

<!-- new capability this task added -->

### v0.4.0 published with four output features

```
level: high
```

#### reason

The release workflow concluded success (run 39444128908), the GitHub Release carries both build artifacts and the Latest flag, and `sam-tagger --version` reported 0.4.0 before the tag was cut.

#### description

```
type: [text]
```

1. Version bumped in `pyproject.toml`, `pixi.toml`, `src/sam_tagger/__init__.py`.
2. Tag `v0.4.0` (annotated) pushed; `main` pushed `269168a..506574b`.
3. GitHub Release created with curated notes covering the four features, their semantics (`--fasta`, parity conditions), and additive-schema upgrade notes.
4. Shipped features: qc-summary strand columns (18-column digest), `--length-dist-out` distributions, `smoothed_deletion`, `total` + 8 rate columns (19-column `error.parquet`).

#### before

v0.3.0 carried the `error.parquet` `to_*` split only; the four output features built this week existed solely on `main`, unreachable by version-pinned consumers.

#### after

v0.4.0 is the Latest release with wheel and sdist attached; the strand columns, length distributions, smoothed deletions, and depth-with-rates outputs are installable artifacts with documented upgrade notes.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: [text]
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

```text
git push origin main v0.4.0
   269168a..506574b  main -> main
   * [new tag]         v0.4.0 -> v0.4.0
release workflow: 39444128908 completed success
assets: sam_tagger-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl (36465 B), sam_tagger-0.4.0.tar.gz (127673 B)
release list: v0.4.0  Latest
sam-tagger --version → 0.4.0
```

:::
